subject: Artifact handoff: retention & erasure controls — Roswell Bank audit

From: Roswell Bank Audit Team <audit@roswellbank.com>

Cc: Roswell Bank Procurement <procure@roswellbank.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Nov 2025 14:05:00 -0500
Subject: Artifact request — retention & erasure controls for SOC2/ISO review

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the call earlier. As part of our SOC 2 / ISO readiness review we need to collect artifacts that demonstrate your retention, residency, and deletion controls in practice. Specifically, can you provide the following by EOD Tue (2 Dec):

- Current retention policy (company-wide and tenant defaults) with effective dates
- Deletion/erasure runbook and a recent run log showing at least one successful tenant erasure (redacted as needed)
- Mapping of TTL/retention to regions (we need to confirm cross-region behavior)
- Export of audit/log entries that show deletion operations and traceability for the sample tenant: roswell-bank-prod (or a redacted example)

If any of the above will take longer, please propose a concrete timeline. We may loop in procurement for any additional attestation language.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Roswell Bank — Audit
audit@roswellbank.com

--
Roswell Bank (external)

Agree with Marcus. A few quick callouts for the packet:

- Retention policy PDF should include the change log and the section that maps policy classes to tenant defaults (we have that in the v2 PDF).
- Deletion playbook: we should add a short attestation paragraph (signed by Security) confirming that deletion procedures are performed according to the runbook and that we retain audit trail for 90 days post-deletion for verification. I will draft that paragraph and attach as a one-page attestation.
- TTL mapping: ensure the spreadsheet has a "last_modified_by" column and a version cell.

I can provide the attestation text by EOD Mon and will review the sample logs for any PII before we hand them over.

Hi Maya — attaching our packet for the items you requested. We are sharing redacted artifacts via a secure Drive bundle and have included a one-page attestation from Security. If you require unredacted forensic logs, please let us know and we will route through procurement and Legal for the access request (we estimate 72 hours after approvals).

Attachments (in Drive + attached copies):
- redwood_retention_policy_v2.pdf (includes change log & tenant mapping)
- deletion_playbook.md (runbook with operator steps and owner contacts)
- erasure_runbook.csv (operational checklist used by infra during erasures)
- sample_log_export_20251129.jsonl (redacted trace of deletion action for a test tenant)
- ttl_mapping_20251130.xlsx (tenant -> region -> TTL table)
- security_attestation_onepage.pdf (signed attestation confirming retention & deletion procedures)

Quick notes:
- Redacted logs remove tenant IDs and IP-level metadata; we preserved operation timestamps and task IDs for traceability.
- TTL mapping: cross-region behavior is governed by the TTL column; if a tenant is pinned to EU it inherits EU TTL values.
- For a live walkthrough, Neha can demo the deletion flow and show the runbook steps on Wed 03 Dec between 09:00–12:00 ET.

Next steps requested from Roswell:
1) Confirm that redacted artifacts are sufficient for your review.
2) If you need full tenant export, confirm procurement point of contact to trigger the access request.
3) Candidate window for a tech walkthrough (if desired).

Thanks and happy to hop on a call if any of the materials need more context.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
